findings.evidence: At fixed ε, the assigned mollification example gives a continuous restriction with endpoint limit 1/2, whereas the zero extension equals 1 almost everywhere on (0,1). If they represented the same a.e. class, continuity would force the restriction to equal 1 throughout (0,1), contradicting that limit.
